planets.name: Kepler-444 c
planets.description: Kepler-444 c crosses its star every 4.55 days and is 0.49 times as wide as Earth, found in 2015.

text.card: Kepler-444 c was found in 2015 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 5 planets known around Kepler-444. Its orbit and size follow Campante et al. 2015's fit, the archive's default.
